# Data Contracts: SimpleBook

**Feature**: SimpleBook Personal Accounting Web App
**Date**: 2025-10-16
**Purpose**: Define TypeScript interfaces, types, validation schemas, and service contracts

## TypeScript Type Definitions

### Transaction Types

**Location**: `src/types/transaction.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Transaction type enum
 */
export type TransactionType = 'income' | 'expense';

/**
 * Transaction entity
 * Represents a single financial record (income or expense)
 */
export interface Transaction {
  /** Unique identifier (auto-generated by IndexedDB) */
  id?: number;

  /** Transaction type: income or expense */
  type: TransactionType;

  /** Transaction amount in NT$ (must be positive) */
  amount: number;

  /** Transaction date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) */
  date: string;

  /** Reference to category ID */
  categoryId: number;

  /** Optional user description (max 200 characters) */
  description?: string;

  /** Creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format */
  createdAt: string;

  /** Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format */
  updatedAt: string;
}

/**
 * Transaction creation input (omits auto-generated fields)
 */
export interface TransactionInput {
  type: TransactionType;
  amount: number;
  date: string;
  categoryId: number;
  description?: string;
}

/**
 * Transaction update input (all fields optional except id)
 */
export interface TransactionUpdateInput {
  id: number;
  type?: TransactionType;
  amount?: number;
  date?: string;
  categoryId?: number;
  description?: string;
}

/**
 * Quick add transaction input (minimal fields)
 */
export interface QuickAddInput {
  amount: number;
  type?: TransactionType; // Defaults to 'expense'
  categoryId?: number;    // Defaults to default expense category
}

/**
 * Transaction filter criteria
 */
export interface TransactionFilters {
  /** Filter by date range */
  dateRange?: {
    start: string; // ISO 8601 date
    end: string;   // ISO 8601 date
  };

  /** Filter by transaction type */
  type?: TransactionType;

  /** Filter by category IDs (multiple selection) */
  categoryIds?: number[];

  /** Search text in description (case-insensitive) */
  searchText?: string;
}

/**
 * Transaction sort criteria
 */
export interface TransactionSort {
  field: 'date' | 'amount' | 'category' | 'type';
  direction: 'asc' | 'desc';
}
```

### Category Types

**Location**: `src/types/category.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Category type enum
 */
export type CategoryType = 'income' | 'expense';

/**
 * Category entity
 * Represents a spending or income classification
 */
export interface Category {
  /** Unique identifier (auto-generated by IndexedDB) */
  id?: number;

  /** Category display name (max 20 characters) */
  name: string;

  /** Category type: income or expense */
  type: CategoryType;

  /** Icon identifier (e.g., 'food', 'transport') */
  icon: string;

  /** Hex color code (e.g., '#22c55e') */
  color: string;

  /** True for predefined categories (cannot be deleted) */
  isDefault: boolean;

  /** Creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format */
  createdAt: string;
}

/**
 * Category creation input (omits auto-generated fields)
 */
export interface CategoryInput {
  name: string;
  type: CategoryType;
  icon: string;
  color: string;
}

/**
 * Category update input (all fields optional except id)
 */
export interface CategoryUpdateInput {
  id: number;
  name?: string;
  icon?: string;
  color?: string;
}

/**
 * Available icon identifiers
 */
export type CategoryIcon =
  | 'salary' | 'bonus' | 'investment' | 'other'       // Income icons
  | 'food' | 'transport' | 'shopping' | 'entertainment'
  | 'medical' | 'education' | 'housing' | 'pet'       // Expense icons
  | 'utilities' | 'insurance' | 'gift' | 'travel';

/**
 * Predefined color palette (WCAG AA compliant)
 */
export const CategoryColors = {
  // Income greens
  green600: '#16a34a',
  green700: '#15803d',
  green800: '#166534',
  green900: '#14532d',

  // Expense reds
  red600: '#dc2626',
  red700: '#b91c1c',
  red800: '#991b1b',
  red900: '#7f1d1d',
  red500: '#ef4444',
  red400: '#f87171',
  red300: '#fca5a5',
  red200: '#fecaca',

  // Custom category colors
  blue600: '#2563eb',
  purple600: '#9333ea',
  yellow600: '#ca8a04',
  orange600: '#ea580c',
  pink600: '#db2777',
  indigo600: '#4f46e5',
} as const;

export type CategoryColor = typeof CategoryColors[keyof typeof CategoryColors];
```

### Budget Types

**Location**: `src/types/budget.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Budget entity
 * Represents monthly spending limit
 */
export interface Budget {
  /** Unique identifier (auto-generated by IndexedDB) */
  id?: number;

  /** Month identifier in YYYY-MM format (e.g., '2025-10') */
  monthYear: string;

  /** Budget limit amount in NT$ (must be positive) */
  limit: number;

  /** Creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format */
  createdAt: string;

  /** Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format */
  updatedAt: string;
}

/**
 * Budget creation input (omits auto-generated fields)
 */
export interface BudgetInput {
  monthYear: string;
  limit: number;
}

/**
 * Budget update input
 */
export interface BudgetUpdateInput {
  id: number;
  limit: number;
}

/**
 * Budget status with calculated values
 */
export interface BudgetStatus {
  /** Budget record */
  budget: Budget;

  /** Total expenses for the month */
  totalExpenses: number;

  /** Percentage of budget used (0-100+) */
  usagePercentage: number;

  /** Amount remaining (negative if exceeded) */
  remaining: number;

  /** Warning level: none, warning (80%), alert (100%+) */
  level: 'none' | 'warning' | 'alert';

  /** Optional message for user */
  message?: string;
}
```

  /** 6-month comparison (bar chart data) */
  monthlyComparison: BarChartData[];

  /** Budget status (if budget exists for current month) */
  budgetStatus?: BudgetStatus;

## Validation Schemas

### Transaction Validation

**Location**: `src/utils/validators.ts`

```typescript
import { isValid, parseISO, isFuture } from 'date-fns';

/**
 * Validation error result
 */
export interface ValidationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
}

/**
 * Validate transaction input
 */
export function validateTransaction(input: TransactionInput): ValidationResult {
  const errors: string[] = [];

  // Validate type
  if (!input.type) {
    errors.push('Transaction type is required');
  } else if (!['income', 'expense'].includes(input.type)) {
    errors.push('Transaction type must be "income" or "expense"');
  }

  // Validate amount
  if (input.amount === undefined || input.amount === null) {
    errors.push('Amount is required');
  } else if (typeof input.amount !== 'number') {
    errors.push('Amount must be a number');
  } else if (input.amount <= 0) {
    errors.push('Amount must be greater than 0');
  } else if (input.amount > 999999999) {
    errors.push('Amount must be less than 1 billion');
  }

  // Validate date
  if (!input.date) {
    errors.push('Date is required');
  } else {
    const parsedDate = parseISO(input.date);
    if (!isValid(parsedDate)) {
      errors.push('Date must be a valid date (YYYY-MM-DD)');
    }
    // Optional: Prevent future dates
    // if (isFuture(parsedDate)) {
    //   errors.push('Date cannot be in the future');
    // }
  }

  // Validate categoryId
  if (!input.categoryId) {
    errors.push('Category is required');
  } else if (typeof input.categoryId !== 'number') {
    errors.push('Category ID must be a number');
  }

  // Validate description (optional)
  if (input.description !== undefined) {
    if (typeof input.description !== 'string') {
      errors.push('Description must be a string');
    } else if (input.description.length > 200) {
      errors.push('Description must be 200 characters or less');
    }
  }

  return {
    valid: errors.length === 0,
    errors
  };
}

/**
 * Validate category input
 */
export function validateCategory(input: CategoryInput): ValidationResult {
  const errors: string[] = [];

  // Validate name
  if (!input.name) {
    errors.push('Category name is required');
  } else if (typeof input.name !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Category name must be a string');
  } else if (input.name.length === 0) {
    errors.push('Category name cannot be empty');
  } else if (input.name.length > 20) {
    errors.push('Category name must be 20 characters or less');
  }

  // Validate type
  if (!input.type) {
    errors.push('Category type is required');
  } else if (!['income', 'expense'].includes(input.type)) {
    errors.push('Category type must be "income" or "expense"');
  }

  // Validate icon
  if (!input.icon) {
    errors.push('Category icon is required');
  } else if (typeof input.icon !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Category icon must be a string');
  }

  // Validate color (basic hex color check)
  if (!input.color) {
    errors.push('Category color is required');
  } else if (!/^#[0-9A-F]{6}$/i.test(input.color)) {
    errors.push('Category color must be a valid hex color (e.g., #22c55e)');
  }

  return {
    valid: errors.length === 0,
    errors
  };
}

/**
 * Validate budget input
 */
export function validateBudget(input: BudgetInput): ValidationResult {
  const errors: string[] = [];

  // Validate monthYear format (YYYY-MM)
  if (!input.monthYear) {
    errors.push('Month is required');
  } else if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(input.monthYear)) {
    errors.push('Month must be in YYYY-MM format (e.g., 2025-10)');
  }

  // Validate limit
  if (input.limit === undefined || input.limit === null) {
    errors.push('Budget limit is required');
  } else if (typeof input.limit !== 'number') {
    errors.push('Budget limit must be a number');
  } else if (input.limit <= 0) {
    errors.push('Budget limit must be greater than 0');
  } else if (input.limit > 999999999) {
    errors.push('Budget limit must be less than 1 billion');
  }

  return {
    valid: errors.length === 0,
    errors
  };
}
```

## Service Contracts

### Transaction Service

**Location**: `src/services/transactionService.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Transaction service interface
 * Handles all transaction CRUD operations
 */
export interface ITransactionService {
  /**
   * Get all transactions
   */
  getAll(): Promise<Transaction[]>;

  /**
   * Get transaction by ID
   */
  getById(id: number): Promise<Transaction | undefined>;

  /**
   * Get transactions for current month
   */
  getCurrentMonth(): Promise<Transaction[]>;

  /**
   * Get transactions with filters
   */
  getFiltered(filters: TransactionFilters): Promise<Transaction[]>;

  /**
   * Create new transaction
   * @throws {ValidationError} if input is invalid
   */
  create(input: TransactionInput): Promise<Transaction>;

  /**
   * Quick add transaction (minimal input)
   * Uses default category and current date
   */
  quickAdd(input: QuickAddInput): Promise<Transaction>;

  /**
   * Update existing transaction
   * @throws {ValidationError} if input is invalid
   * @throws {NotFoundError} if transaction doesn't exist
   */
  update(input: TransactionUpdateInput): Promise<Transaction>;

  /**
   * Delete transaction
   * @throws {NotFoundError} if transaction doesn't exist
   */
  delete(id: number): Promise<void>;

  /**
   * Get transactions by date range
   */
  getByDateRange(start: string, end: string): Promise<Transaction[]>;

  /**
   * Get transactions by category
   */
  getByCategory(categoryId: number): Promise<Transaction[]>;

  /**
   * Calculate total for transactions
   */
  calculateTotal(transactions: Transaction[]): number;
}
```

### Category Service

**Location**: `src/services/categoryService.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Category service interface
 * Handles all category CRUD operations
 */
export interface ICategoryService {
  /**
   * Get all categories
   */
  getAll(): Promise<Category[]>;

  /**
   * Get categories by type
   */
  getByType(type: CategoryType): Promise<Category[]>;

  /**
   * Get category by ID
   */
  getById(id: number): Promise<Category | undefined>;

  /**
   * Get default categories
   */
  getDefaults(): Promise<Category[]>;

  /**
   * Get custom categories
   */
  getCustom(): Promise<Category[]>;

  /**
   * Create new custom category
   * @throws {ValidationError} if input is invalid
   * @throws {DuplicateError} if name already exists for type
   */
  create(input: CategoryInput): Promise<Category>;

  /**
   * Update custom category
   * @throws {ValidationError} if input is invalid
   * @throws {NotFoundError} if category doesn't exist
   * @throws {ForbiddenError} if trying to update default category
   */
  update(input: CategoryUpdateInput): Promise<Category>;

  /**
   * Delete custom category
   * Reassigns transactions to uncategorized
   * @throws {NotFoundError} if category doesn't exist
   * @throws {ForbiddenError} if trying to delete default category
   */
  delete(id: number): Promise<void>;

  /**
   * Initialize default categories (on first launch)
   */
  initializeDefaults(): Promise<void>;

  /**
   * Get or create uncategorized category
   */
  getOrCreateUncategorized(type: CategoryType): Promise<Category>;
}
```

## Error Types

**Location**: `src/types/errors.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Base error for application
 */
export class AppError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public code: string,
    public statusCode: number = 500
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = this.constructor.name;
  }
}

/**
 * Validation error (400)
 */
export class ValidationError extends AppError {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public errors: string[] = []
  ) {
    super(message, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 400);
  }
}

/**
 * Not found error (404)
 */
export class NotFoundError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message, 'NOT_FOUND', 404);
  }
}

/**
 * Forbidden error (403)
 */
export class ForbiddenError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message, 'FORBIDDEN', 403);
  }
}

/**
 * Duplicate error (409)
 */
export class DuplicateError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message, 'DUPLICATE', 409);
  }
}

/**
 * Database error (500)
 */
export class DatabaseError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message, 'DATABASE_ERROR', 500);
  }
}
```
